declared_gaps.duvet: REMOVED from the frame 2026-08-05 (owner circled it and asked what it was). A folded duvet is free-form drapery (R8): it may not be hand-modelled, R1 halted it after two reshapes, and C2-r5c showed the stand-in fabricated a read the target does not have - its hem wall covered a platform face the target shows OPEN. The law written after the owner first caught this in r3 says a soft-goods placeholder that does not read as its class LEAVES THE FRAME until the cloth phase; that law was not applied to its own object. The bed now renders as platform + mattress, which is honest, and the duvet returns as the cloth sim first object.
declared_gaps.lamp_stem: REMOVED (audit + owner's own catch). A bare post whose provenance read 'carries shade'. The audit measured hard containment for the lamp: no pixel may fall left of u=1057, and the stem projects to u 1061-1075 with nothing like it in the reference. The shade is retained; what held it up was invented. R10.
declared_gaps.shelf_col_base: REMOVED (audit). An 818 mm plinth under the etagere that is 100% occluded in BOTH frames, invented so the boards would have something beneath them - the lamp_stem pattern exactly. Its own prov quoted 'top z~3030', a number belonging to the COLUMN, pasted onto a base whose top is 818. The carcass now runs continuously from the worktop, which is what the reference shows.
declared_gaps.part_stile_M: REPLACED by the pair the target actually has: leaf_stile_R and mullion_M. One 72 mm stile was standing in for two ~50 mm members with a 44 mm gap.

audit_conflicts.bed_width: The audit asks for far side -2550 -> -2055 (width 1595 -> 2100) from the plinth's FOOT-end silhouette through an assumed rounded-corner plan. NOT APPLIED. Against it: the headboard's own top edge dies at u~730 giving -2401..-2581 (direct, on the object's own feature); the band it anchors to starts at a measured -2550; and -2055 would put 495 mm of headboard back inside the open slot, which is the defect the owner caught by eye on 2026-08-05. An indirect solve does not overturn a direct one plus the owner's eye. Settle it by measuring the bed's FAR long side directly.
audit_conflicts.bed_mattress_x_head: The audit asks x head -1490 -> -1325. NOT APPLIED: the headboard occupies x -1490..-1314, so a mattress reaching -1325 would interpenetrate it by 11 mm. The audit gives no contact for the mattress head; it stays against the platform head until the mattress/headboard junction is measured.
audit_conflicts.left_wall_x: Two zones disagree. The etagere's corner arris at u=65.1 wants left_wall_x ~= -4772; the console corner exiting frame-left bounds it at <= -4724; the desk depth closes at -4750. NOT CHANGED — the backwall zone returned UNRESOLVED for this wall and said plainly that nothing in its view constrains it. Settle it with a plan dimension, not another view.
audit_conflicts.bed_width_SECOND_EVIDENCE: The pillow measurement is independent evidence for the audit's wider bed. Two pillows measured at 800 mm each need a mattress of at least 1640; ours is 1265, and the placement gate refused the build the moment the measured width was applied. So the bed-width question now has evidence on both sides: FOR the current 1595 — the headboard's own top edge dying at u~730, the band starting at a measured -2550, and the owner's eye catching the overlap; FOR a wider bed — the foot-end silhouette solve and now the pillow span. The likely reconciliation is that the HEADBOARD IS NOT THE BED: the audit itself found the panel runs 410 mm past the bed's near side, so measuring the headboard's end has never been measuring the bed's. SETTLE IT by fitting the platform's own FAR long side directly — that edge, and no proxy for it. Until then the platform keeps the value the owner's eye endorsed, because a build that reintroduces a defect he caught is worse than one that is 500 mm narrow.

STATUS: NOT THE FRAME OF RECORD. Applied in one batch 2026-08-05 and the owner's verdict on the render was 'เละกว่าเดิม'. The individual measurements here are good; applying them together is what failed. Specifically, the wardrobe end (-2550 -> -2299) and the door wall face (-1076 -> -900) came from two different agents and between them squeezed out the OPEN SLOT that round 2's three-way consilience had established. A value produced by a consilient solve cannot be replaced by one better measurement of one of its inputs — the solve must be re-run. Frame of record reverted to spec_r11; these findings return one at a time with a LOOK between, local ones first.
